title: Futu 2026 Market Outlook: Flexible and Diversified Investment Strategies for a New Global Economic Normal
summary: Today, Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited ("Futu"), a leading tech broker in Hong Kong, held its annual investment strategy sharing session. At the event, Arnold Tam, Chief Analyst at Futu Securities, Joe Yu, Executive Director of Institutional and Private Wealth Services at Futu Securities, and Daniel Tse, Managing Director at Futu Securities, shared forward-looking insights and investment strategies across multiple market hot topics. They anticipate increased market volatility next year, alongside a shift from this year’s “single-theme strategy” toward a more “multi-polar strategy”. Investors are advised to remain flexible and diversify across asset classes and income streams to mitigate risk effectively and capture a broader range of emerging opportunities.
